query: UPDATE recording_deletion_jobs SET mode='permanent',state='queued',stage='queued',retry_at=now(),attempts=0,error=NULL,error_kind=NULL,finished_at=NULL,permanent_requested_by=COALESCE(permanent_requested_by,$2),permanent_requested_at=CASE WHEN permanent_requested_by IS NULL AND $2::bigint IS NOT NULL THEN now() ELSE COALESCE(permanent_requested_at,now()) END,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1
